cautions.en: The one-time developer registration fee amount was not visible on the fetched page; it is a one-time cost per developer account, not a subscription.

capabilities.en: App release management: internal sharing, closed/open testing, pre-launch reports and staged production releases.
Growth and analytics tools including acquisition reporting, store listing A/B experiments, custom store listings and translation services.
Monetization via Google Play Billing for in-app products and subscriptions, with price experiments.
Quality monitoring through Android vitals reports, Android Performance Tuner and app size analysis.

limitations.en: Requires a one-time paid developer registration to publish any app; the exact fee was not shown on the page fetched.
Tied exclusively to distribution on the Google Play Store; not usable for other Android app stores or platforms.

missingAlternatives.reason: Direct equivalent console for publishing iOS apps, not in the catalogue
